display.purpose: Terrain names, report repository name, control headings only.

label.purpose: Legend, control codes, counts, file data.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Hover and tab state transitions only.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The only filled action; starts analysis.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #fdfaef; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 15px; font: 500 11px/1 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #522e7c; border-color: #522e7c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source input
components.description: The source path rule inside the start control.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="本地路径或 GitHub 地址" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--panel-solid); color: var(--text); border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 0; font: 400 16px/1.4 "Cascadia Code", monospace; outline: 0; } .ds-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Report tab
components.description: A leg in the report route rail.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); text-align: left; font: 400 11.5px/1.4 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-tab.is-active { color: var(--accent); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Control row
components.description: One technology as an orienteering control description.
components.css: .ds-control { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 13px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--text); } .ds-code { color: var(--accent); font: 400 9px/1.2 "Cascadia Code", monospace; } .ds-control strong { font: 700 23px/1.05 "RepoLens Map", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-count { color: var(--faint); font: 400 8px/1.2 "Cascadia Code", monospace; }

narrative.overview: RepoLens is a terrain, not a dashboard. The interface borrows the discipline of an orienteering map: a cream paper field, contour lines that describe the shape of the ground, a legend that names what the colours mean, and one course purple that belongs only to the active route. The report is read as a sequence of legs; each technology is a control description with a code, a name, a category, and the evidence count that lets a reader verify it.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground with flat forest, contour, and course colours.
One active route in purple; no glow, no glass, no gradient text.
A route rail with nodes in the report; rows read as control descriptions.
Authored contour lines only on the home surface.
No rounded cards, no lifted panels, no ambient shadow language.

rules.name: The Purple Course Rule
rules.body: Purple is the active route. A screen may use it for the current leg, the primary action, and selection; never for a heading, a decorative rule, or an inactive icon.

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: Every colour that carries meaning must be explainable in the header legend or the control description. If a colour cannot be named, remove it.

rules.name: The Code Is Not a Kicker Rule
rules.body: Control codes and route numbers are coordinates in the data, not labels above headings. Do not add codes to a heading that has no coordinate in the product.

dos: Do keep purple for the active route and primary action only.
Do use one-pixel rules, flat paper, and square geometry as the depth system.
Do keep control codes, evidence counts, and legend swatches explainable.
Do keep authored contour lines on the home surface only.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, glass, gradient text, or glow.
Don't use purple as a decorative wash or inactive state.
Don't turn route nodes into chip ornaments; they mark actual report legs.
Don't add a second display face or a system display face.
Don't replace control rows with equal-sized card grids.
